source: WEG press release: WEG provides solutions for high-power cooling systems in (10-08-2026)

players.product: Power and distribution transformers and substations (T&D) for grid connection, plus Marathon alternators for data-center energy backup and industrial pumps / ventilation equipment for cooling systems

quarterly_data.signal: WEG supplied electric motors and variable frequency drives for 10 plug-and-play cooling modules built by Enfrio, an Italian cooling-system manufacturer, for generators with power outputs exceeding 30 MW: forty 30 kW, 4-pole motors and 40 CFW500 drives with IP66 protection, delivered on a compressed production and delivery schedule. WEG positions its motors and drives for cooling systems in high-power generation and data center applications.
quarterly_data.figure: 40 motors (30 kW) and 40 CFW500 drives for 10 cooling modules
quarterly_data.counterparty_role: customer (motors and drives for cooling modules)
